summary: Only about three in ten adults go to services weekly, so a congregation is one group among many.
realLife: Gallup found about 30 percent of adults attend weekly or nearly weekly, down from 42 percent two decades earlier, with large differences by religious group.
sources: Gallup, church attendance by religious group: https://news.gallup.com/poll/642548/church-attendance-declined-religious-groups.aspx
